disclosure: Stock synthetic voices generated offline with Kokoro v1.0; no actor session or individual voice clone was commissioned. Only the fixed authored quotations below are rendered. No model or speech service ships in the game.
processing: PCM16 mono master retained; optional exact-quotation phrase segments with bounded speed/pause and 8ms phrase edges; delivery peak normalized to 0.72, 8ms clip edges and 80ms head/tail silence.
reviewStatus: Seventy-five fixed stock synthetic quotations. Twelve additions: ten for Asa, one for Nia, one for Ives. All preceding sixty-three deliveries unchanged; nine distinct stock cast styles. Authored route, exact speaker/text, signal and native playback checks; no commissioned actor or independent listening acceptance.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: A green light on the dispatch channel. It meant the evacuation crew had been assigned. I let it mean they'd finished.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Dispatch spoke through a shift relay. No face. I knew the channel had authority to assign crews; I didn't know who was on it.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Now ask what your sentence claims. The hour can't answer every question you put to it.

lines.speaker: Sister Lumen
lines.text: People will repeat the sentence before they inspect the source. You can say what the receipt contains and what still needs checking. Or you can name the tower now and accept what happens when it challenges your proof.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: I want a morning that doesn't begin with someone else choosing what I remember. That won't give the night shift their morning back.

lines.speaker: Sister Lumen
lines.text: Because somebody should know which cup they take their tea in. Even when the city has made a case file out of them.

segments.text: Because somebody should know which cup they take their tea in.
Even when the city has made a case file out of them.

lines.direction: Ordinary attention, then the human cost of being reduced to a file; keep care separate from endorsement.

lines.speaker: Quill
lines.text: Mara Voss, Helion logistics. Glass Chapel edits her memory at dawn. Bring me the original hour, intact.

segments.text: Mara Voss, Helion logistics.
Glass Chapel edits her memory at dawn.
Bring me the original hour, intact.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: I signed the coolant dump. Ward Nine. Three hundred on the night shift. I want that sentence to stay in my mouth.

segments.text: I signed the coolant dump.
Ward Nine.
Three hundred on the night shift.
I want that sentence to stay in my mouth.

lines.speaker: Kerr
lines.text: You can't unwrite the depot. You can stop asking me to pretend you kept the private part. Tell me what you'll put beside that promise.

segments.text: You can't unwrite the depot.
You can stop asking me to pretend you kept the private part.
Tell me what you'll put beside that promise.

lines.speaker: Sister Lumen
lines.text: You may leave a private message at the desk. I decide whether to answer. That's all the permission I'm giving.

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: The wall has room for a voice. It has never had room for an excuse.

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: I have the pencil. The rain can wait with me.

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: Leave that beside what you know. Don't make it a clean story for me.

lines.speaker: Ives
lines.text: Your name is still on file. That is what the tower will keep.

lines.speaker: Nia Pell
lines.text: Now I want to hear the words before anyone uses them. No address. No photograph. If I stop, you stop.

segments.text: Now I want to hear the words before anyone uses them.
No address. No photograph.
If I stop, you stop.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: I want to answer in my own name. A private statement to the Ward Nine records desk. I won't make the clinic my alibi.

segments.text: I want to answer in my own name.
A private statement to the Ward Nine records desk.
I won't make the clinic my alibi.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Not the board. Not this week. I will answer the desk in my own name. I won't give you a crowd because you asked for one.

segments.text: Not the board. Not this week.
I will answer the desk in my own name.
I won't give you a crowd because you asked for one.

lines.speaker: Kerr
lines.text: No recipient entry. That was the part I asked you to keep.

lines.speaker: Kerr
lines.text: You brought the case. You also put my name in their register after promising not to. Those aren't the same line.

lines.speaker: Kerr
lines.text: We agreed they could register it. Leave that on the receipt.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Will you sit for a while? There's nothing to take down.

segments.text: Will you sit for a while?
There's nothing to take down.

lines.direction: An invitation followed by reassurance; keep the established Mara voice. No promise of absolution or intake outcome.

lines.speaker: Kerr
lines.text: One walk without counting the steps first. Not another door to stand in. Just the table where the rain doesn't land in the soup.

segments.text: One walk without counting the steps first.
Not another door to stand in.
Just the table where the rain doesn't land in the soup.

lines.direction: A hoped-for ordinary walk; separate the former guard identity from the table he wants. No successful fitting or treatment is implied.

lines.speaker: Quill
lines.text: Fifty now. Two hundred when the shard is in my hand and not wandering around in your bloodstream. Kerr is her shadow. Kerr is why the number is not prettier.

lines.speaker: Quill
lines.text: Ninety. I will not go higher unless you are secretly three people. Two hundred on delivery, and if you die I am billing the corpse for my time.

lines.speaker: Quill
lines.text: Cute. Fifty. Count it if you want. The count will not change, and neither will my face.

lines.speaker: Quill
lines.text: Three ways in. The front sells forgiveness to anyone with an appointment. The hatch behind the incinerator is for people who still sweat. The choir door runs on an old Helion pad. I would not kiss it.

lines.speaker: Sister Lumen
lines.text: You are not on the penitent list. Dawn puts Mara Voss in that chair so Helion can edit a crime out of her. The next sentence should be one you can survive.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Helion told me the dump was a flush, not a kill. I signed because the night shift was already in the building and I thought the tower would move them. They did not move them.

lines.speaker: Kerr
lines.text: That glass is Mara's hour. Helion pays me so the Ward Nine memo stays in her head, not in your pocket.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Ask me while I'm still here. They bought the hour so I wouldn't have to answer twice.

lines.speaker: Quill
lines.text: Her life. Her appointment. Helion booked the chair; I booked you.

lines.speaker: Quill
lines.text: Get it there. Asa will leave you a clearance for one passenger.

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: No speeches. Put your shoulder here. Someone has to sleep upstairs tonight.

lines.speaker: Ives
lines.text: If you allege an instruction, identify its issuer. We will challenge anything less.

lines.speaker: Sister Lumen
lines.text: They do not need to tell every landlord where they sleep. Dispatch wants a route it can verify. I need a notice people can actually use.

lines.speaker: Sister Lumen
lines.text: Come back when the window has passed. A plan deserves an answer, even if it was a good plan.

lines.speaker: Kerr
lines.text: Helion paid me to know the weight of that glass. You are the part of the weight I can still invoice.

lines.speaker: Sister Lumen
lines.text: The shard is a week old, wherever it went. I called you back because memory gets thin if nobody walks it back to the wall. Come with me, or tell me you are done and mean it.

lines.speaker: Nia Pell
lines.text: You promised a witness. I promised nothing to a transmitter. I need care, a room they don't own, and a say in which words leave it. Can you do those separately?

lines.speaker: Kerr
lines.text: I can keep this off the register if you give me a clinic transfer I can sign. Get the desk to accept it. Then move.

lines.speaker: Sister Lumen
lines.text: We cannot tell her the room is private. Say exactly what happened.

lines.speaker: Sister Lumen
lines.text: We can move her again. It won't erase the first register entry. Say that to her before you call this repaired.

lines.speaker: Nia Pell
lines.text: If you have another question, leave it with the clinic. I decide whether to answer. Or let this be the last question for a while. I can choose that even if you helped me.

lines.speaker: Sister Lumen
lines.text: Next time you are dying, come here first. We owe you a cheaper kind of edit.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: They still bill my shifts against it. Get it out clean and take the receiver.
lines.attribution: "I need the old maintenance key out of this terminal," Edda says.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: You paid someone to carry the paper so you could sit here. I remember the chair, too.

segments.text: You paid someone to carry the paper so you could sit here.
I remember the chair, too.

lines.direction: Quiet recognition; distinguish company from the delivered envelope.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: I kept the hour for myself. You don't owe me company because you heard what I did.

segments.text: I kept the hour for myself.
You don't owe me company because you heard what I did.

lines.direction: An unpressured boundary; no accusation for declining.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: I did this after you left. You took the envelope; I kept the hour. I wanted you here, too. Both things can be true.

segments.text: I did this after you left.
You took the envelope; I kept the hour.
I wanted you here, too.
Both things can be true.

lines.direction: Admit disappointment without withdrawing ownership of her time.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: The envelope went in the next batch. That hour didn't need a receipt to have happened.

segments.text: The envelope went in the next batch.
That hour didn't need a receipt to have happened.

lines.direction: Matter-of-fact delay followed by remembered company.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: The envelope is still here. I'm glad you sat with me. I still need to send it.

segments.text: The envelope is still here.
I'm glad you sat with me.
I still need to send it.

lines.direction: Warmth and unfinished work coexist; do not imply dispatch.

lines.speaker: Kerr
lines.text: That was the part I asked you to keep.

segments.text: That was the part I asked you to keep.

lines.direction: Understated acknowledgement, not a reward or treatment claim.

lines.speaker: Kerr
lines.text: You wrote my name after promising not to. Don't call this private.

segments.text: You wrote my name after promising not to.
Don't call this private.

lines.direction: Firm, restrained disappointment; retain the recorded breach.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: Your export records a cancellation. My ledger can show whether it reached the shift. Compare them. I have to work here tomorrow.

segments.text: Your export records a cancellation.
My ledger can show whether it reached the shift.
Compare them.
I have to work here tomorrow.

lines.direction: Practical instruction, then the personal employment cost.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: Ask before you put my name on a public copy.

segments.text: Ask before you put my name on a public copy.

lines.direction: Clear permission boundary; no implied authorization.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: I'll sign for payroll to use my name here. Not on your public packet. Leave the witness recording and patient list out. I need a shift, not another version of the accusation.

segments.text: I'll sign for payroll to use my name here.
Not on your public packet.
Leave the witness recording and patient list out.
I need a shift, not another version of the accusation.

lines.direction: Businesslike private permission; distinguish work from publication.

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: The names can be spoken either way. This is a different promise: an account someone can question after you leave.

segments.text: The names can be spoken either way.
This is a different promise: an account someone can question after you leave.

lines.direction: Patient distinction between memorial and public evidence.

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: Correct it here. A correction belongs beside what people already heard.

segments.text: Correct it here.
A correction belongs beside what people already heard.

lines.direction: Direct correction without humiliation or erased consequences.

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: say them. If you sold them, you can still say them. The wall does not check your receipt.

segments.text: say them.
If you sold them, you can still say them.
The wall does not check your receipt.

lines.direction: Open invitation with the old transaction still acknowledged.

lines.speaker: Ives
lines.text: A maintenance signature isn't an issuing key. A witness isn't a server. What exactly are you asking people to believe?

segments.text: A maintenance signature isn't an issuing key.
A witness isn't a server.
What exactly are you asking people to believe?

lines.direction: Controlled institutional challenge; sharpen the final question.

lines.speaker: Nia Pell
lines.text: Use the words I approved. You can name me as the source through Sera. No address, no new story about how brave I was, and no sentence saying the room made me owe you this.

segments.text: Use the words I approved.
You can name me as the source through Sera.
No address, no new story about how brave I was, and no sentence saying the room made me owe you this.

lines.direction: Deliberate ownership of each limit, not frightened gratitude.

lines.speaker: Sister Lumen
lines.text: This buys a way to answer them. I will not mark it as three new appointments.

segments.text: This buys a way to answer them.
I will not mark it as three new appointments.

lines.direction: Measured practical care, no invented clinic outcome.

lines.speaker: Sister Lumen
lines.text: The observer saw the old time. Taking down the paper cannot take that back.

segments.text: The observer saw the old time.
Taking down the paper cannot take that back.

lines.direction: Calm acknowledgement of consequences that persist.

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: The clothes are what they have left. Help me get them clean?

segments.text: The clothes are what they have left.
Help me get them clean?

lines.direction: Ordinary shared work; light invitation after the loss.

lines.speaker: Asa
lines.text: Keep it cold. Get a receipt. No patient names. If the service route stays private, I can spare one passenger clearance. Register the handover and that route retires.

segments.text: Keep it cold.
Get a receipt.
No patient names.
If the service route stays private, I can spare one passenger clearance.
Register the handover and that route retires.

lines.direction: Practical instructions, then a firm route limit.

lines.speaker: Asa
lines.text: We can finish the delivery. We can’t pretend they didn’t see us.

segments.text: We can finish the delivery.
We can’t pretend they didn’t see us.

lines.direction: Steady after a setback; finish the work without denying exposure.

lines.speaker: Asa
lines.text: One crossing. Tell me when the week is over what it was for.

segments.text: One crossing.
Tell me when the week is over what it was for.

lines.direction: Modest earned promise, with curiosity rather than ceremony.

lines.speaker: Asa
lines.text: I can answer for what we saw. I can’t sign for the part we didn’t.

segments.text: I can answer for what we saw.
I can’t sign for the part we didn’t.

lines.direction: Honest limits, no blame or invented receipt.

lines.speaker: Asa
lines.text: The parcel got there, privately. One crossing was what I owed you.

segments.text: The parcel got there, privately.
One crossing was what I owed you.

lines.direction: Quiet acknowledgement of the actual private delivery.

lines.speaker: Asa
lines.text: The parcel got there. The route is still exposed and retired.

segments.text: The parcel got there.
The route is still exposed and retired.

lines.direction: Separate completed delivery from a permanently exposed route.

lines.speaker: Asa
lines.text: The batch book finally answered. Received after you left. That doesn't buy back our passenger route.

segments.text: The batch book finally answered.
Received after you left.
That doesn't buy back our passenger route.

lines.direction: Relief at the answer without rewriting its timing.

lines.speaker: Asa
lines.text: And remember that the people receiving your work have names too.

segments.text: And remember that the people receiving your work have names too.

lines.direction: Ordinary attention to the people at the other end of the job.

lines.speaker: Asa
lines.text: Choose who you ask to hold the door.

segments.text: Choose who you ask to hold the door.

lines.direction: Offer a small personal question without promising escape.

lines.speaker: Asa
lines.text: Just keep the receipt honest about whose morning it bought.

segments.text: Just keep the receipt honest about whose morning it bought.

lines.direction: Understand paid work while keeping its human cost visible.

lines.speaker: Nia Pell
lines.text: The room is mine to name. That matters more than what you called the job.

segments.text: The room is mine to name.
That matters more than what you called the job.

lines.direction: Clear personal agency; gratitude supplies no new permission.

lines.speaker: Ives
lines.text: We kept the name. Burning the badge was a hobby.

segments.text: We kept the name.
Burning the badge was a hobby.

lines.direction: Dry institutional confidence; the file outlasts the badge.

discardedCandidates.reason: Quote explicitly belongs to Edda, while the scene primary portrait is Ives. Replaced before release by attributed Edda delivery; game state unchanged.
